task: Ground factual claims for work timing and bottleneck visibility.
output_summary: Added phase-level work timing records, a work-timer validation/summary tool, evaluator timing targets, timing workflow/prompt guidance, and timing display in coordination board plus Workspace Monitor.

evidence.reliability: Tracked Python CLI implementing check and summarize commands.
Tracked self-documenting config defining timing phases and thresholds.
Tracked timing record for the current task.
Tracked evaluator code and tests include timing_summary_targets.
Tracked board generator and generated board include timing and bottleneck columns.
Tracked monitor collector and UI read timing reports and display summaries.

claims.statement: A reusable work-timer CLI was added under _tools.
verification_steps: Read the tool source and ran its unit tests.

claims.statement: The timing policy defines phase-level work timing and bottleneck thresholds.
verification_steps: Read the work timing policy and ran config contract checks.

claims.statement: The current task has a partial timing record and the work-timer check command returned ready.
verification_steps: Read the timing record and ran the check command.
Read evaluator code and ran agent-platform tests.

claims.statement: The coordination board can display timing and bottleneck columns from timing_report.
verification_steps: Regenerated the coordination board and inspected the generated Markdown.

claims.statement: Workspace Monitor can ingest timing reports and display timing summaries for tasks.
verification_steps: Ran Workspace Monitor tests, typecheck, build, and full workspace-health.

uncertainty_notes: Timing thresholds are initial defaults and should be tuned after several real timing records accumulate.
The current task timing is partial because the timing workflow was introduced after the task started.
limitation_notes: The tool does not automatically measure every command; future agents still need to create or update timing records.
Historical tasks were not backfilled with exact timing because that would create false precision.
